Test inputs, unchanged:

- `spec.json`: the CommonMark 0.31.2 spec examples, from goldmark v1.8.6's
  `_test/spec.json` (CC BY-SA 4.0, John MacFarlane).
- `goldmark-*.txt`: goldmark v1.8.6's own test cases (`_test/extra.txt` and
